html:
Pay better with Afterpay.

Tint now. Drive away. Get more time to pay.

Tint a Car now accepts Afterpay, which means you can split your purchase in 4 instalments over 6 weeks with ZERO interest.

Get the right look, protection and privacy for your ride sooner using Afterpay!

Afterpay empowers customers to access the things they want and need, while still allowing them to maintain financial wellness and control, by splitting payments in four. All easily managed through the Afterpay app!

Easy to use.

Use the app to checkout
& manage your purchase.

Fast approval.

No more waiting around;
approval is quick & easy!

Flexible payment plans.

Choose your payment dates &
make payments in the app.

What do you need to get started?

To create an Afterpay account, you need to be an Australian/New Zealand
resident & over 18 years old.

You’ll also need:

  • Email address
  • Phone number
  • Photo ID
  • VISA or MasterCard (credit or debit)
  • Upfront cost: 20% of the purchase price

How it works.

1. Download the Afterpay app & create a new account.

2. Head into Tint a Car and say that you want to pay for your tint, wrap or paint protection using Afterpay.

3. During checkout, choose your first payment date and set your schedule on-the-spot. Payments can be made weekly for fortnightly to suit your budget and lifestyle.

Download the Afterpay app.

Browse for shops and services, manage your payment schedule and get exclusive offers from your favourite brands.
